packageRules.description: Group non-major devDependency updates; automerge once CI passes.
React peer — never auto-bump the peer range; surface majors for manual review.

engines + peerDependencies are the PUBLISHED contract, not the dev toolchain. `rangeStrategy: bump` would narrow them to whatever this repo happens to develop against — engines.node >=20 to >=24.18.0, or a peer range to the newest patch — locking consumers out for no gain. They move by hand, with intent. `.node-version` is unaffected, so the toolchain still tracks Node.
